auditLog.title: Audit Log
auditLog.description: Chronological record of system actions, configuration changes, and job retries

action.description: Name of the action executed, e.g. RETRY_JOB, UPDATE_CONFIG, TOGGLE_CIRCUIT_BREAKER, TRIGGER_CANARY

category.description: Category classification of the audit log

details.description: Detailed human-readable description of what changed or what was executed

target.description: Target identifier such as job ID, service endpoint, or setting key

performedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID or system identifier

performedByEmail.description: Email address or system username of the actor

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the action occurred

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Collection of system and user audit trail records
